notes: Weather shader, threat button, harder-hitting fires

The weather overlay is now a smooth shaded field like the threat assessment: dust, haze, heat, rain, fog and snow blend softly across region edges and break into patches, with blowing dust, rain and snow moving on top
Threat assessment moved out of the Intel column to a ◍ Threat button under ☁ Weather. Only one of the two map shaders shows at a time

Fire missions hit much harder: fighters in the blast are killed or wounded, survivors are pushed back from the impact, rounds on the enemy around troops in contact cut down the attackers, suppress their fire and can break the contact outright, and enemy armor and strongholds take heavier damage
The drone camera always boxes known targets in red, including enemy armor in cities we have intel on, whatever the drone overlay setting

Vehicles stick to the roads: driving cross-country is now much slower (soft sand, wadis and berms), so route planning sends columns along the MSRs and minor roads to staging areas and AOs, and only leaves the road for the last stretch. Highways are the fastest way to cover any distance

Explosions on the map now flash, fireball and leave rising smoke with a shock ring and flying debris, and hits leave scorched, irregular burn marks with a crater, blast rays and glowing embers for the first day, instead of flat circles
